Wang et al. [ 205 , 206 ] applied sintering + forging technology to prepare a thrust chamber simulation parts with a nominal composition of Nb-16Si ( Fig. 39 ), by using Nb powder (purity 99.9%) and Si powder (purity 99%) with an average particle size 50 μm.
The Nb-16Si-2Fe alloy prepared by reactive hot pressing sintering shows an average phase size of about 3 μm, and its room temperature elongation reaches 2% [50] .
The Nb-16Si alloy prepared by spark plasma sintering presented a fine equiaxed structure, and the room-temperature compressive strain increases from 1% to 11% [206] .

The fracture toughness of Nb-16Si-25Ti-2Al-2Hf-7Cr alloy prepared by the SPS method reaches 15 MPa m 1/2 , which is greatly improved compared with the as-cast alloy with the same composition, and the corresponding fracture surface exhibited obvious dimple morphology [240] .

Nb-26Ti-22Si-6Cr-3Hf-2Al prepared by laser melting deposition (LMD) using the pre-alloyed material powder exhibited the microstructure composed of Nb SS and Nb 5 Si 3 , and the size of the Nb 5 Si 3 phase is about 10–20 μm [65] .

The room-temperature fracture toughness of directionally solidified Nb-Si based alloys has reached 15-28 MPa m 1/2 , and the strength at 1200 °C is twice than that of the typical 2GSX, and the creep properties under the stress of less than 100 MPa are at the same level with 2GSX.

evidence.quote: This may be due to supersaturated solid solution caused by mechanical alloying of Nb and Si particles through high-energy ball milling.
